post.summary: Register an image you are about to upload and get a presigned upload URL
post.description: Member uploads are images only. The asset is yours: only you can finalize it or attach it to your profile, a post or a message. You can delete it while nothing references it.

contentType.description: Must be an `image/*` type. The size is checked when the upload is finalized.

kind.description: The media class, derived by the server from the content type.

source.description: Where the file came from: `library` is the org's media uploaded by staff, `member` is a person's own upload.

url.description: A short-lived signed URL that shows a ready library file. `null` while pending and for a member upload, which is served with what it is attached to.

downloadUrl.description: The same file as a download saved under its filename. `null` when `url` is.

post.description: Reads the stored size and content type. A file that is not an image or is over the size limit is discarded and answered with 409. A finalized file moves where the upload URL no longer reaches; finalizing it again returns it unchanged.

get.summary: List an automation's runs — a deleted automation's runs remain reachable (audit trail)

post.description: Dispatches the same run again with the automation's current steps; the new outcome replaces the run's previous one. For a webhook this resends the delivery to its current URL. A run that is still running can't be rerun (409).

post.summary: Create a webhook — returns its signing secret
post.description: Each subscribed event is POSTed to `url` as the JSON event envelope (`id`, `type`, `version`, `orgId`, `occurredAt`, `data`), signed per the Standard Webhooks spec: `webhook-id` (the event id, stable across retries), `webhook-timestamp` (unix seconds) and `webhook-signature` (`v1,` + base64 HMAC-SHA256 of `{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}`, keyed with the base64-decoded part of the `whsec_` secret). Any non-2xx response or timeout is a failed attempt and is retried. Deliveries are the webhook's automation runs: `GET /api/automations/{id}/runs`.
